core: Non-iron transition metal transport and detoxification
name: Copper, manganese and cadmium ion transport and detoxification
rationale: Members cover transport, homeostasis and detoxification of copper, manganese, cadmium and cobalt including metallothioneins; cadmium detoxification and copper/manganese transport separate it from the zinc, iron and MTF1 metal-response neighbours.

name: Catecholamine and serotonin synthesis, degradation and sympathoadrenal development
rationale: All members concern synthesis, MAO/COMT degradation and handling of catecholamines and serotonin plus development of the catecholaminergic adrenal and sympathetic lineage, which neighbours (BH4 cofactor, SLC6 reuptake, organic cations) lack.

qualifier: ISG15 and host suppression of viral replication
name: ISG15 and interferon-stimulated host restriction of viral replication
rationale: Members share interferon-alpha-induced antiviral effectors that limit viral entry, replication and release, with ISG15 conjugation distinguishing it from neighbouring OAS/PKR and type I IFN signature themes.

name: Serine, glycine and proline metabolism with vitamin B6 activation
rationale: Members cover serine, glycine, proline, glyoxylate and aspartate-family amino acid metabolism and pyridoxal phosphate activation, unlike neighbours centred on aromatic, sulfur amino acids, BH4 or molybdenum cofactor.

name: Polyamine metabolism, transport and eIF5A hypusination
rationale: Members cover putrescine/spermidine/spermine synthesis, interconversion, oxidation and transport plus spermidine-derived hypusine modification of eIF5A promoting elongation, which separates it from the tryptophan/NAD and protein hydroxylation neighbours.

name: Intestinal epithelium and pancreatic progenitor lineage differentiation
rationale: Members describe CDX/HNF4-driven intestinal absorptive epithelium identity and pancreatic progenitor/endocrine lineage development, distinct from neighbours on mammary/reproductive glands, beta-cell insulin secretion and definitive endoderm formation.

name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and antibody-dependent cytotoxicity
rationale: All members concern IgG Fc-gamma receptor activation, its inhibitory regulation, phagocytic cup formation, ADCC and type II hypersensitivity, unlike neighbours on BCR, Fc-epsilon/mast cell and SIRP inhibition.

name: TCR-driven T cell activation and IL-2 production
rationale: Members share positive regulation of TCR signaling, T cell activation and IL-2 production, in contrast to neighbours on B cells, T cell differentiation and co-inhibition.

core: Mitochondrial amino acid and short-chain acyl-CoA catabolism
name: Branched-chain and lysine catabolism with lipoyl and biotin cofactors
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial branched-chain amino acid and lysine catabolism, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes, biotin-dependent carboxylases, protein lipoylation and their inborn organic acidemias, which TCA cycle, CoA synthesis and serine/B6 neighbours lack.

name: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and maple syrup urine disease
rationale: All members concern the BCKDH, PDH, OGDH and OADH multienzyme complexes and MSUD-causing defects in BCKDH, which neighbours on lipoylation, glycine degradation and broader BCAA catabolism lack.

qualifier: vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and vitamin D
name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and vitamin D metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors plus vitamin D hydroxylation and CYP-related vitamin defects, separating it from retinoid, vitamin E and phosphate/mineralization neighbours.

qualifier: apoptotic cells and oxidized LDL foam cells
name: Efferocytosis and oxidized LDL-driven macrophage foam cell formation
rationale: Members share phagocyte recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells, amyloid-beta and oxidized LDL with cholesterol storage and foam cell differentiation, unlike microglial activation and scavenger receptor class neighbours.

qualifier: AP-1 induction by UV and stress stimuli
name: AP-1 immediate-early transcriptional response to UV and stress stimuli
rationale: Members share rapid AP-1/NR4A-type transcriptional responses to UV, phorbol ester, nitric oxide, TNF and growth signals, whereas neighbours centre on KRAS/FOSL targets or TAK1-JNK/p38 kinase regulation.

name: APOBEC3 cytidine deaminase restriction of retroviral replication
rationale: Members concern APOBEC3G DNA cytosine deamination of retroviral reverse transcripts, its Vif-mediated degradation and clearance of foreign nucleic acid, distinct from HIV entry, RNA editing and somatic hypermutation neighbours.

core: Dendritic cell regulation of T cell activation
name: Dendritic cell differentiation and costimulatory CD4 T cell activation
rationale: Members share dendritic cell differentiation/activation and APC-contact costimulation driving CD4 T cell proliferation, unlike neighbours of DC surface signatures, negative T cell regulation and NK inhibition.

qualifier: filopodia and cell polarity via EPHB
name: Rho GTPase and EPHB control of filopodia and cell polarity
rationale: Members share Rho-family (RHOF, citron) and EPHB-driven actin and microtubule organisation controlling filopodia and cell shape, unlike neighbours on lamellipodia/ruffles or dendritic spine plasticity.

name: Neutral amino acid plasma membrane transport and Hartnup disorder
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane uptake of neutral amino acids such as tryptophan and glycine and SLC6A19 defects causing Hartnup disorder, unlike neighbours on cationic, proline/imino or peptide transport.

name: Cardiac chamber, valve and vascular endothelial morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover cardiogenesis, septation, valve and conduction system formation, cardiomyocyte differentiation, BMP signaling and arterial/venous endothelial specification, unlike neighbours on gastrulation, axial patterning, muscle adaptation and smooth muscle phenotypic switching.

name: Nuclear pore complex assembly and inositol phosphate transport
rationale: Members concern nuclear pore complex assembly, disassembly and post-mitotic reformation plus nuclear-cytosolic inositol phosphate transport, which neighbours on protein/RNA export and nuclear envelope breakdown lack.

qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptors
name: Growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: All members are growth hormone, prolactin or leptin receptor signaling via JAK-STAT, distinct from erythropoietin/thrombopoietin, thyroid hormone and somatic growth regulation neighbours.

name: Fc and complement receptor-driven myeloid inflammatory activation
rationale: Members cover Fc and complement receptor signaling, ADCC, neutrophil degranulation and macrophage/monocyte inflammatory activation and hypersensitivity, broader than the FCGR phagocytosis neighbour and unlike respiratory burst or formyl peptide chemotaxis neighbours.

qualifier: Tfh help and memory B cells
name: Germinal center Tfh help and memory B cell formation
rationale: Members share T follicular helper differentiation, ICOS costimulation, germinal center B cell differentiation and memory B cell signatures, unlike neighbours on general B cell homeostasis and plasma cells.

qualifier: white and brown adipocytes with thermogenesis
name: White and brown adipocyte differentiation and adaptive thermogenesis
rationale: Members concern white, brown and beige fat cell differentiation, PPARG regulation and cold- or diet-induced thermogenesis, unlike neighbours on lipid droplets, triglyceride metabolism and LXR targets.

name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members cover de novo pyrimidine synthesis, salvage, catabolism and deoxyribonucleotide production and breakdown, unlike neighbours on de novo purine synthesis and ADA/PNP defects.

name: Coding-region mRNA stabilization and translational promotion
rationale: Members share protection of mRNA from deadenylation-dependent decay via coding-region determinant binding and promotion of cytoplasmic translation, unlike miRNA silencing, ARE-mediated destabilization, stress granule and decapping neighbours.
